page.notes: The scan is printed upside down, and the Latin is badly worn, mirrored and bleeds through from the other side. Most of this transcription is unreliable. The clear words are "Vtcunque", "posquam", "uentis", "uela", "in otio & in umbra viuere, quàm in Foro vel", "cum inuidia & metu verum" and "FINIS". The line-by-line reading and the number of lines are uncertain. Many lines are marked illegible rather than guessed. The lines cut off at the right and left edges of the text block are fragments and should be checked against a better scan or the original.
